name: Step-3.5-Flash
context_scaling: llama3 rope scaling (factor 2, high_freq 32) applied to full-attention layers only
attention_variant: GQA with interleaved sliding-window (36 of 48 layers, window 512) + full attention
notes: Vendor: 196.81B total (196B backbone + 0.81B head) / 11B activated; safetensors total 199.38B; our config arithmetic gives 195.8B total / 10.8B active, matching the vendor figures to ~1%. This is SLIDING-WINDOW + INTERLEAVED rather than fully sparse attention, and the config makes the pattern explicit: layer_types over 48 entries is 12 full_attention + 36 sliding_attention, sliding_window 512, num_attention_groups 8, att_impl_type GQA. kv_cache_bytes_per_token is recorded as 196,608 which is num_layers x kv x dim x 2 x 2 with all 48 layer slots counted (48 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 196,608 B/token, 192 KiB) - but this is the WORST CASE and overstates steady-state badly: the 36 sliding layers are bounded to 512 tokens each. True steady-state cache is approximately 12 full layers x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 x context + 36 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 x 512, i.e. a bounded ~688 KB per sequence regardless of length. A reader sizing a server should use that, not the 192 KiB figure; the number is kept uniform with the schema's formula but the derivation matters more than the value. MoE: 288 experts, top-8, PLUS a shared expert (share_expert_dim 1280). moe_layers_enum lists layers 3-44 as MoE (42 of 48 entries); moe_router_activation sigmoid with scaling factor 3.0, and use_moe_router_bias true. hidden 4096, moe_intermediate_size 1280, intermediate 11264. Unusual detail worth recording: rope_theta is a PER-LAYER LIST of 48 values - 5000000.0 on the 12 full-attention layers and 10000.0 on the 36 sliding layers - and rope_scaling is llama3 type (factor 2, high_freq_factor 32) applied only to full_attention layers (yarn_only_types ['full_attention']). num_nextn_predict_layers 3. Context 262144. Apache-2.0.
